evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a flanged L pipe run; even the top view keeps the bend and flange discs legible at 64 px; nothing floats (all 12 bolts seated, A16 pass).
evidence.V2: Clear big/medium/small: long teal pipe body > gold flanges and coupling ring > small ink hex bolts, plus dark bore as an accent.
evidence.V3: Chunky oversized flanges and coupling ring against a fat smooth pipe give a confident toy-like stylised read; bend radius is generous rather than a stiff primitive joint.
evidence.V4: Flange faces and coupling ring show a consistent chamfer band catching light (end_bore and coupling close-ups); hex bolts have bevelled tops; no razor edges.
evidence.V5: Elbow close-up shows visible segment faceting along the bend: polygonal kinks in the outer contour and stepped shading bands, plus a thin darker line hugging the left contour; flanges and coupling are clean (minor, caps at 1).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one body hue (teal) + gold accent + ink bolts; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the body hue, keeping the gold/ink accents.
evidence.V7: 1264 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000: under target.
evidence.V8: One white material LF_VertexColor with vertex colours, kit gold accent and ink darks, chamfered flanges and smooth shading match the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision (Box per straight if walked on), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.
